record.bible_text: Then said<WH0559><WTH8799> the LORD<WH03068> unto me, Go<WH03212><WTH8798> yet, love<WH0157><WTH8798> a woman<WH0802> beloved<WH0157><WTH8803> of <FI>her<Fi> friend<WH07453>, yet an adulteress<WH05003><WTH8764>, according to the love<WH0160> of the LORD<WH03068> toward the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478>, who look<WH06437><WTH8802> to other<WH0312> gods<WH0430>, and love<WH0157><WTH8802> flagons<WH0809> of wine<WH06025>. <RF>of wine: Heb. of grapes<Rf>

So I bought<WH03739><WTH8799> her to me for fifteen<WH06240><WH02568> <FI>pieces<Fi> of silver<WH03701>, and <FI>for<Fi> an homer<WH02563> of barley<WH08184>, and an half homer<WH03963> of barley<WH08184>: <RF>half...: Heb. lethech<Rf>

And I said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto her, Thou shalt abide<WH03427><WTH8799> for me many<WH07227> days<WH03117>; thou shalt not play the harlot<WH02181><WTH8799>, and thou shalt not be<WH01961><WTH8799> for <FI>another<Fi> man<WH0376>: so <FI>will<Fi> I also <FI>be<Fi> for thee.

For the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478> shall abide<WH03427><WTH8799> many<WH07227> days<WH03117> without a king<WH04428>, and without a prince<WH08269>, and without a sacrifice<WH02077>, and without an image<WH04676>, and without an ephod<WH0646>, and <FI>without<Fi> teraphim<WH08655>: <RF>image: Heb. a standing, or, statue, or, pillar<Rf>

Afterward<WH0310> shall the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478> return<WH07725><WTH8799>, and seek<WH01245><WTH8765> the LORD<WH03068> their God<WH0430>, and David<WH01732> their king<WH04428>; and shall fear<WH06342><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068> and his goodness<WH02898> in the latter<WH0319> days<WH03117>.<CM>
